column3: Something tiny just ended it, and you both know which something.
The camel did not break today. The camel filed a formal grievance.
One more thing and you are done. The one more thing arrived.
Your limit has a door in it now, and it opens outward.
The final straw is never the heaviest one. It is simply last.
Enough is a sentence you finally say out loud.
You are not overreacting. You are out of tolerance, which is different.
The measure is full and the pitcher is still being offered.
You announced your departure, then shopped for more of the same.
Resignation letter framed, box unpacked.
The limit moved again, quietly, like it has been trained.
You did not reach your limit. You rebranded it.
Limits that flex are just preferences with good posture.
Threat four is underway. Everyone knows threat four.
You keep resetting the counter and calling it strength.
Almost gone is a room you have furniture in.
Say the expensive thing first. The bill is smaller than the fear.
Apply with the bad odds. Ask before the meeting ends.
Nerve, spent now, all of it at once.
Someone had to. You have volunteered loudly.
The move is audacious and the timing is yours.
Risk the question. Silence has been charging you rent.
Go anyway, badly, early, unsuitable.
Confidence is sometimes just appetite with good diction.
Aim corrected first, then bold, in that order, please.
Someone said a confident wrong thing with total commitment. Possibly you.
All horn, no steering, impressive decibels.
Nerve without a plan is weather, and you are forecast.
Nerve billed as strategy; the invoice arrives shortly.
Somebody's certainty about you has outgrown their knowledge of you.
Forward, said the compass, pointing at the wall.
The gall is real. The direction is not.
Everyone's cup but yours is on empty. Top up, then continue.
You have given until the giving stopped meaning anything. Rest counts.
Fill your own tank. It is not selfish, it is basic plumbing.
The well you keep lowering buckets into needs rain occasionally.
Refuse one request today as an experiment in survival.
Serve yourself once, at the front, while it is warm.
Overflowing for everyone, parched where nobody looks.
There is a version of generous that includes you. Try it.
You keep pouring from a dry well and calling the dust effort.
Sacrifice has a ledger now and the ink is resentment.
Saint hours, unpaid, and the congregation never thanks the statue.
Half of the giving is now complaint about the giving.
You are owed rest and you have spent the credit on others.
Some people you help are actually bills you keep paying.
The tank is not refilling because you drive with the lights on.
Empty and furious is a warning light, not a personality.
Feelings kept indoors eventually throw their own parties.
What you do not say still rises. Aim it, do not shelf it.
Say the small thing early or it arrives as a large thing later.
Pressure sealed in a glass container is a project, not a mood.
The unsaid has been fermenting. Taste test it before it chooses a night.
Emotion leaves a trail, and yours is heading for the kitchen at 2am.
Pour it somewhere honest before it pours itself randomly.
Sealed feelings do not evaporate, they carbonate.
That was the eruption. The village needs honesty now, not cork.
It came out sideways and slightly alcoholic in tone.
Clean up the blowup before you schedule the next suppression.
You said it all, wrong order, wrong hour, mostly true.
The cork failed; stop buying corks, start writing inventories.
Honest mop, better than this heroic lid.
The flood is over. The paperwork begins now.
Whatever just detonated was twelve months pressurised and about a week acknowledged.
Small, cheap, warm, yours, tonight, no apology.
Joy at budget price still counts full price.
Take the treat. The treat is the assignment tonight.
Pleasure is not a reward for finishing, it is maintenance.
The good thing costs a few pounds and eleven minutes.
Savor the small thing before your brain explains it away.
Happiness arrives mostly ungrand, and mostly fed.
Say yes to the edible, immediate, unimpressive delight.
Soothing has quietly become stalling with better seasoning.
The comfort is doing a job it cannot do, and everyone tastes it.
You ordered the distraction again. It arrived, it helped, it solved nothing.
Treat first, deal later, later being a rich country you will never visit.
Avoidance snacks well but it never fills up.
That is not dinner, that is a ceasefire.
The small pleasure is now the whole diet and the whole plan.
Somewhere between bite one and bite six, the actual thing waited.
Someone is spending good years on the display version.
The shine is expensive and it never once helps carry anything.
Care less what it photographs like, more what it is like on a Tuesday.
Image is a hungry roommate who never pays.
Someone near you is auditioning to be envied. The seats are empty.
Ego polishes, reality loads the dishwasher. Only one of these is life.
The right crowd photo outlives the right reason by almost nothing.
Wearing the trophy instead of having earned it, twice.
Out of frame at last, and briefly unrecognisable.
The mirror has been winning the argument without losing a match.
Look away once. The world reports back kindly, surprisingly.
Somebody counted the followers and found nobody home. Possibly the follower.
Humiliation stings and then, absurdly, relieves.
The photographs outperformed the life and the life knows it.
Reflection check: is the reflection managing the face.
Blush now, lighter afterwards, that is the whole prescription.
Something about you was eight once and is still lovely. Feed it.
Do the useless thing today, with commitment, for the laugh of it.
What did you love before anyone graded you at it. That.
Play is not the reward for work. It is a vitamin.
Take yourself down half a notch and see who remains.
The serious adult is also sometimes insufferable. Guest the other one.
Fun is a form of maintenance nobody prescribes.
Build the silly thing. Keep it slightly broken.
Someone small is driving, and the wipers are tantrums.
The meeting had one agenda item and it was a feeling from 1998.
Acting your shoe size helped nobody and impressed the wrong people.
Somebody is waiting to be parented while holding a mortgage.
Sulking is a negotiation strategy and it is not working.
That reaction is three years old. Check which one.
The grown-up is on a break. The break has become the tenancy.
Inner small, outer overloaded, both need directions.
Somebody needs you, and that somebody has your name on it.
The reliable one is allowed to be held, also, occasionally.
Ask for the thing you keep handing out.
Care given without a remainder eventually forecloses on the giver.
Nobody thought to ask. Say the answer out loud first.
You are also a person you are responsible for.
Being needed is a nice view, not a full plate.
Tend the tender, and be one tonight.
Sacrifice that charges interest to everyone nearby.
You smother and call it weather, and everyone inside is damp.
Guilt about resting is the martyr's rent. Stop paying it.
Care that costs everything gets repaid in resentment, at compound rates.
Some love has curdled into administration. Check a sample.
Depleted devotion is generous-looking and useless-tasting.
The saint is furious and the halo is crooked.
Overgive, then bill the room, quietly, in sighs.
Six arms is an overallocation. Begin with four.
Everything lands on you partly because you are standing under everything.
Drop one plate loudly. The floor is fine, you are fine.
Delegation feels like losing control and works like gaining hours.
Step back one inch from the whole operation. Watch, shakily, what survives.
The empire runs. The emperor is permitted lunch.
Not everything that wobbles needs a hand, especially your specific hand.
You are doing the job of a slightly larger person.
Help declined, burnout accepted, terms not negotiated.
Put three of the six arms down and name the fear that stays up.
The micromanaging was anxiety wearing a lanyard.
Collapsing from heroics is still collapsing.
Refusing the offer to sit is not how chairs work.
Some load is fine. All load is a choice with your fingerprints.
You asked for nothing and got everything, thank you, no, thank you.
Tired now, warned earlier, delegated never. Let's pick one.
Decline the evening, answer to nobody, enjoy the strange quiet.
Step out of the group, not off the planet.
The thoughts only arrive when the chat is archived.
Solitude is the room where your own voice stops being an interruption.
Not every withdrawal is avoidance. Some are reading.
Let the plans die gently. A lighter week is the successor.
The noise was never the point.
Disappear for a proper evening. Return with the answer.
Hiding has been wearing solitude's coat and it fits badly.
Weeks of not replying, defended as philosophy.
The retreat became the residence, rent-free, light rent-free.
Open the door a proper crack. The post arrives either way.
The quiet was medicine. This is now just dust.
You are unreachable, which was the goal, and is now the problem.
Loneliness with better branding. The rebrand is due.
Some recluses need a window, not a cave upgrade.
Whatever you started is working, invisibly, underground, at root speed.
Water, wait, refrain. Two of those you are bad at.
The harvest is weeks ahead of the evidence.
Slow is not stalled. Leaves disagree with your calendar, politely.
New things run on a different clock. Borrow some patience from it.
Keep tending the unglamorous middle of it.
You planted in season. That is the whole good news.
Bloom is a deadline the soil laughs at.
You drowned it in attention. Starve it slightly and try again.
Tending now out of guilt is a second watering. Stop.
Some things root only when unobserved, unprodded, unfussed at.
Neglect now hides behind last week's enthusiasm.
You expected the fruit in week one and blame the tree.
That is not care, that is hovering with a watering can.
Patience is also not giving up loudly every Thursday.
Leave the poor thing alone like a grown-up.
Earn tonight without earning it, which is the point of tonight.
Permission granted, retroactively, by you, for the indulgent thing.
The night off is not a lapse, it is protocol.
Some things are simply for the mouth and the moment.
Enjoy it fully, guilt is an upcharge nobody agreed to.
Want is information and the fridge is a source.
Take the extra. The extra is the medicine, poorly prescribed, effective.
You are allowed the unproductive pleasure, loudly.
Reward issued before any work was requested. Auditors are confused.
Some comfort is anaesthetic wearing napkins as a bib.
You are ahead of yourself on the good thing again.
Pleasure first, penance after, the loop turning sweetly and pointlessly.
The regret arrives right after the last bite. Budget for it.
Everything is a treat now, which is how the treats stopped working.
Comfort dosed past relief starts feeling like numbness with seasoning.
Savour it, then check which hole it is filling.
Some threads were never holding anything up but you.
Loose is the correct state for several of your attachments.
Cut the draining tie and feel the room's oxygen change.
One goodbye, unceremonious, and the week gets lighter.
Not every circle is worth completing. Some are nooses with manners.
The group costs you. The invoice finally arrived.
Let go of the hand that only holds when it wants.
Release is a skill and this is your practised week.
The knot re-ties itself nightly and you call it loyalty.
You severed something load-bearing by accident, or by Tuesday.
Back again, said nothing, sat down, the attachment is undefeated.
Still attached and the thing knows it, smugly.
That was the lifeline, not the red tape.
Scissors of good intent, wound unexamined.
You keep ending it on Thursdays and unending it by Friday.
Loose thread, pulled thread, you, holding two ends.
